name: Slow pong
summary: A pong match between two friends where each gets one hit a day: the ball creeps across a drawn table in real time, the receiver taps where to aim and hits it back before it lands, a missed day loses, the old rally fades behind the ball, and everyone else in the chat backs a side.
useWhen: calvin vs will, one hit a day, loser buys tio's
a slow game two of us can play all week
rivalry thing for the chat to watch
pong but it takes days lol
settle the bet with a really slow match
dontUseWhen: a quick game everyone plays now (use tray-stack)
tracking a bet with odds (use over-under)
a tournament with many players (use group-tourney)

stakes.description: The bet, short, e.g. 'loser buys Tío's'

left.description: Left player's name in the chat; empty for an open paddle

right.description: Right player's name in the chat; empty for an open paddle

hours.description: Hours for the ball to cross the table, usually 24

rally.description: Hits so far in the rally

minutesLeft.description: Minutes until the ball lands on the other side, as of now

backers.description: Friends backing a side, with an optional line in their words
